component.name: RadioPod
component.summary: Privacy-first internet radio and podcast player

description.p: RadioPod plays internet radio and podcasts. Find stations in the community-run Radio-Browser database and podcasts in Podcast Index, group them into playlists, and listen.

A podcast sits in your list beside the stations. Tap it to resume the episode you were part way through, or else start the newest. Each episode remembers where you stopped, so you can pick it up on another device.

Your stations, podcasts, playlists and listening progress are stored encrypted in your own Solid Pod, so nobody, not even the server administrator, can see what you listen to. Without a login the library is kept on this device instead and nothing is sent anywhere.
Playlists import and export as M3U and PLS, and podcasts as OPML.
